name: Korie
short_desc: A small, fast media server that Jellyfin's apps play from
description: A small, fast media server for the whole household, that Jellyfin's own apps play from.
author: MightyX3N
sharing_note: Shared this way, people reach Korie's outside port, where they sign in to their household first. Korie can also share itself through its own playit.gg link (Admin › Households). Use one of the two, not both.

${ROOT_FOLDER_HOST}/media.label: Where are your films, series and music?
${ROOT_FOLDER_HOST}/media.hint: Pick the folder on your NAS that holds them. Korie only reads it.
